name: Benzaiten Enishi
source:
Enishi is the apprentice goddess of marriage who fell from the sky and dropped the pheromone onto the protagonist so she's claiming to be his imouto at the moment. She's quite stubborn and will accuse her "nii-san" of being a pervert every opportunity possible.

[From [url=http://liemyx.livejournal.com/1263.html]Liemyx's review[/url].]
